description.breakdown: Breakdown will group the holds by discipline, hold type, role, blocker, or another field, as bars or as a matrix of two fields. A row or a cell will open its lines.
description.lines: Lines will list every line on hold in one table, with its holds, disciplines, blockers, oldest age, and sizes. Presets will sort it, for example oldest first or easiest to release.
description.blockers: Blockers will show what the holds wait for and how the blockers depend on each other. It will rank them by the number of lines each one frees when it is solved.
description.history: History will compare two snapshots and list the holds that were added, released, changed, or reopened. It will also show the trend of open holds and the list of snapshots.
description.people: People will list, for each name on the export, the holds raised, open, and released, the oldest open hold, and the median age.
description.follow-up: Follow-up will hold the watchlist, the notes, and the follow-ups that are due or overdue.
description.rules: Rules will hold the blocker rules, the manual overrides, the merged remarks, the age bands, and the column mapping of the workspace.
